name: Blue Ghost Mission 3

surface_window.note: The landing date is not published.

outcome_note: Will deliver six NASA CLPS science payloads to the Gruithuisen Domes.

payloads.name: Lunar Vulkan Imaging and Spectroscopy Explorer
payloads.purpose: Lander and rover cameras and spectrometers studying the silica-rich domes.

payloads.name: Heimdall
payloads.purpose: Four-camera system imaging regolith through all mission stages.

payloads.name: Sample Acquisition, Morphology Filtering, and Probing of Lunar Regolith
payloads.purpose: Robotic arm with sieve-scoop and penetrometer collecting regolith.

payloads.name: Neutron Measurements at the Lunar Surface
payloads.purpose: Measures thermal and epithermal neutron count rates at the surface.

payloads.name: Radio wave Observation at the Lunar Surface of the photo-Electron Sheath
payloads.purpose: Low-frequency radio receiver measuring the photoelectron sheath.

payloads.name: Photovoltaic Investigation on the Lunar Surface
payloads.purpose: Compares several solar-cell technologies in the lunar environment.

sources.title: Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) Deliveries (page updated May 06, 2026)

notes: 'Gruithuisen Domes' is not a single IAU feature, so no coordinate is asserted.
Mission facts are compiled by hand from NASA pages, LROC images and the IAU Gazetteer; every record carries its sources, last read 2026-09-23.
1 of 1 missions have fields no source confirms; they are listed as unconfirmed, never filled in.
Numbers are Sun and Earth geometry at the target over the mission's surface window, not what any lander measured.
